domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee who applies for leave and whose leave balances are tracked. Employment status governs eligibility to submit leave requests.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — employee is currently employed and eligible for leave
INACTIVE — employee is temporarily deactivated (e.g. long-term leave, suspension); cannot submit new leave requests
TERMINATED — employment has ended; all balances are frozen and no new requests allowed

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Core aggregate representing an employee's application for leave. Owns the approval lifecycle and triggers balance adjustments on state transitions.
lifecycle_states: DRAFT — request created but not yet submitted; editable by employee; no audit trail for approvals
SUBMITTED — request sent for manager review; employee cannot edit; manager can approve/reject
APPROVED — manager has approved; balance is deducted; employee may cancel
REJECTED — manager has rejected; terminal state; balance unaffected
CANCELLED — request withdrawn by employee (from DRAFT, SUBMITTED, or APPROVED); balance restored if previously deducted

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a category of leave. Each LeaveType has exactly one active policy at any time. Drives balance initialization and validation rules (e.g. minimum notice, max accumulation).
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — policy is in effect; governs new leave requests and balance calculations
INACTIVE — policy is retired; does not apply to new requests but historical balances remain

domain_entities.name: Balance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining days for a specific policy and fiscal year. Updated atomically when a LeaveRequest is approved or cancelled.
lifecycle_states: ACTIVE — balance is in effect for the current fiscal year; can be drawn against
EXHAUSTED — remainingDays is zero; no further leave of this type can be taken this fiscal year
FROZEN — employee is no longer active; balance preserved for audit but cannot be used

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Informs employees and managers of leave-related events (submission, approval, rejection, cancellation). Triggered by LeaveRequest state transitions.
lifecycle_states: PENDING — notification created but not yet delivered
READ — recipient has acknowledged the notification
ARCHIVED — notification is no longer in the active inbox

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that defines its rules.

business_rules: BR-001 — Employee eligibility: Only employees with employmentStatus = ACTIVE may submit a LeaveRequest. INACTIVE and TERMINATED employees are rejected at submission time.

BR-002 — Sufficient balance: Before a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the employee must have remainingDays >= requestedDays for the corresponding Balance (matched by employeeId, policyId, and fiscalYear). If insufficient, the request must be rejected.

BR-003 — Balance deduction on approval: When a LeaveRequest transitions from SUBMITTED to APPROVED, the corresponding Balance.usedDays is increased by the number of working days in the request range, and Balance.remainingDays is decreased accordingly. This must happen atomically within the same transaction.

BR-004 — Balance restoration on cancellation: When a LeaveRequest transitions from APPROVED to CANCELLED, the previously deducted days are restored to the Balance (usedDays decreased, remainingDays increased). Cancellation from DRAFT or SUBMITTED does not affect balance.

BR-006 — Minimum notice enforcement: If the associated LeavePolicy.minimumNoticeDays is set, the number of calendar days between the submission date and startDate must be >= minimumNoticeDays. Emergency leave (LeaveType.EMERGENCY) bypasses this check.
BR-007 — Date validity: startDate must be on or before endDate. startDate must not be in the past at the time of submission (DRAFT → SUBMITTED transition).

BR-008 — Manager approval requirement: If LeavePolicy.requiresManagerApproval is true, the LeaveRequest must be approved by the employee's manager (employee.managerId). The system validates that approvedBy matches managerId. If requiresManagerApproval is false, the request auto-approves on submission.

BR-009 — Overlapping requests: An employee cannot have two LeaveRequests with overlapping date ranges in SUBMITTED or APPROVED status for the same LeaveType. Overlap detection must run at submission time.

BR-010 — Fiscal year alignment: A LeaveRequest's startDate and endDate determine which fiscal year's Balance is affected. If the request spans two fiscal years, the days are prorated and deducted from each year's Balance respectively.

BR-012 — Audit on state change: Every LeaveRequest state transition (DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED, SUBMITTED→REJECTED, any→CANCELLED) must produce an AuditRecord capturing entityType='LeaveRequest', entityId, action, oldValues (previous status), newValues (new status), performedBy, and performedAt.

BR-013 — Notification on state change: The following transitions trigger a Notification: DRAFT→SUBMITTED (notify manager), SUBMITTED→APPROVED (notify employee), SUBMITTED→REJECTED (notify employee), APPROVED→CANCELLED (notify manager).

BR-014 — Policy active check: A LeaveRequest can only reference a LeavePolicy where isActive = true. If a policy is deactivated, existing approved requests are unaffected but new requests using that policy are rejected.

BR-005 — Max accumulation cap: When a Balance is initialized or rolled over for a new fiscal year, remainingDays must not exceed LeavePolicy.maxAccumulation. Any excess from the prior year is forfeited.

BR-011 — Balance status transitions: Balance transitions to EXHAUSTED when remainingDays reaches 0. Balance transitions to FROZEN when the associated Employee's employmentStatus becomes INACTIVE or TERMINATED. A FROZEN balance cannot be drawn against.
domain_notes:
## Lifecycle states introduced

### Employee.employmentStatus
- ACTIVE → INACTIVE (temporary deactivation; blocks new leave requests)
- ACTIVE → TERMINATED (employment ends; freezes all balances)
- INACTIVE → ACTIVE (reactivation; balances unfreeze)
- INACTIVE → TERMINATED
- TERMINATED is terminal

### LeaveRequest.status
- DRAFT → SUBMITTED (employee submits; triggers manager notification if requiresManagerApproval=true)
- DRAFT → CANCELLED (employee withdraws draft; no balance impact)
- SUBMITTED → APPROVED (manager approves; balance deducted; employee notified)
- SUBMITTED → REJECTED (manager rejects; terminal; employee notified)
- SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (employee withdraws; no balance impact)
- APPROVED → CANCELLED (employee cancels approved leave; balance restored; manager notified)
- REJECTED is terminal (no further transitions)
- CANCELLED is terminal

### LeavePolicy lifecycle
- ACTIVE → INACTIVE (policy retired; blocks new requests but historical data preserved)
- INACTIVE → ACTIVE (policy reinstated)

### Balance.status
- ACTIVE → EXHAUSTED (remainingDays hits 0)
- EXHAUSTED → ACTIVE (balance restored via cancellation or new fiscal year rollover)
- ACTIVE → FROZEN (employee becomes INACTIVE or TERMINATED)
- EXHAUSTED → FROZEN
- FROZEN → ACTIVE (employee reactivated)
- FROZEN is terminal for terminated employees

### Notification.status
- PENDING → SENT (delivery confirmed)
- SENT → READ (recipient acknowledged)
- SENT → ARCHIVED (removed from active inbox)
- READ → ARCHIVED

## Key domain invariants
- LeaveRequest is the aggregate root; Balance updates are transactional side-effects of LeaveRequest state changes
- LeaveType is a value enum, not an entity — it has no lifecycle
- LeavePolicy governs exactly one LeaveType; only one active policy per LeaveType at any time
- Balance is scoped to (employeeId, policyId, fiscalYear) — one row per employee per policy per year
- All state-changing operations on LeaveRequest produce an AuditRecord (GP-002)
- Manager approval is validated against Employee.managerId (RBAC alignment for GP-005)
